conversation_history.user_query: 查一下各个学校的各科成绩
conversation_history.final_sql: SELECT T1.School, T2.AvgScrMath, T2.AvgScrRead, T2.AvgScrWrite, (T2.AvgScrMath + T2.AvgScrRead + T2.AvgScrWrite) AS TotalScore FROM schools AS T1 JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds ORDER BY TotalScore DESC
